csv_scope_of_work: The City of Cheyenne ( City ) is currently seeking proposals for the following work as specified: The City of Cheyenne, Wyoming is seeking qualification statements and service proposals from consulting groups for the Design of the New City of Cheyenne Fleet Maintenance Mechanic Shop located at 2731 Old Happy Jack Road, Cheyenne, Wyoming. The City of Cheyenne is looking to add a new mechanic shop to the Fleet Maintenance Facility. As the City grows, more space is needed to accommodate vehicle repairs for its expanding fleet. The new mechanic shop will need to contain approximately 6 bays with plenty of storage for tools, equipment, supplies, etc, a paint booth, one set of bathrooms, and a small office space. Features will include extra ventilation for welding, two oil pits, and one lift

short_description: Design services for a new fleet maintenance mechanic shop in Cheyenne, Wyoming.

project_scope: Design of a new mechanic shop addition for the City of Cheyenne Fleet Maintenance Facility. services: Consulting and design services including architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, and civil engineering.
relevance_explanation:

- Primarily an automotive maintenance workshop, not a long-span, bridge, stadium, or special lightweight structure.

fee_explanation: No design fee or fee basis is stated in the tender text. Useful inputs available: architectural and civil engineering design for a new 6-bay fleet maintenance shop with ancillary spaces and special workshop features. Without construction cost, area, or procurement fee schedule, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived.
references_qualifications: Qualification statements and service proposals are requested from consulting groups.
